title: 3D characters generated and textured by AI
author: whistling_frank

comments.author: Gloomy-Radish8959
comments.body: and rigged too, apparently?  Is this starting from a rigged figure and applying generated textures / topology deformations?

replies.author: whistling_frank
replies.body:
The tool is generating the mesh and texture fully from text prompting, actually. The flow works like this:  
1. Provide a prompt describing the character  
2. Generate 2D images of the character (iterate until you like the 2D image)  
3. Generate the 3D mesh and texture given your prompt and image selections  
4. Auto rig the 3D character.

comments.author: Wise_Rich_88888
comments.body: What are you using for this?

replies.author: whistling_frank
replies.body:
It's a tool I'm building at [charmed.ai](https://charmed.ai)  
The character generator should be released in the next week or so. Making this video is part of the QA process!

replies.body: I just seen this and am bummed.

comments.author: Mekkablood
comments.body: Very nice, is the rigging for just humanoid shaped objects, or would it work on something like the race car you made too?

replies.author: whistling_frank
replies.body: V1 is for bipedal humanoids- other object types require some more hierarchical understanding when making the mesh. For example- we need the tires of the car to be separated from the chassis. Right now they're one manifold.
